Jar opens a briefcase with glowing 2% Kojic Acid, Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin hexagons.
Small jar fires a light beam from the briefcase at the ghost in the mirror.
Fingertip scoops thick white cream from the jar at night.
Woman sleeping under the moon; wipe to sunlight with 'AFTER 2 WEEKS'.
Before/after split of the woman; both halves still show similar dark spots, frowning.
Jar packshot with swirl; title 'DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid Night Cream, Glow Fusion Formula'.
